name: SAP SD
certifications: SAP Certified Associate - SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition, Sales (C_TS462)
SAP Certified Associate - Implementation Consultant - SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition, Sales (C_S4CS)

beginner.summary: For sales coordinators, customer service staff and new consultants with no SAP experience. Covers the sales organisation, customer and material master data, quotations and sales orders, pricing, availability checks, deliveries and goods issue, billing, credit management, returns, sales contracts, third-party and consignment sales, rebates, sales output, reporting and the links to finance and logistics in S/4HANA.
prerequisites: Understands basic selling work: quotations, orders, deliveries and invoices
Comfortable with business software and spreadsheets
Access to an SAP S/4HANA training system
outcomes: Maintain customers and sales master data
Run order to cash from quotation to invoice in S/4HANA
Handle pricing, availability, credit blocks and returns
Run special sales processes and report on sales

intermediate.summary: For key users and junior consultants who can run order to cash. Covers configuration of the sales organisation, customer master data, sales document types, item and schedule line categories, copy control, pricing, taxes, availability checks, shipping, picking and packing, billing and revenue account determination, credit management, incompletion and free goods, variant configuration, intercompany sales, condition contracts, EDI and returns in S/4HANA.

advanced.summary: For senior SD consultants, order-to-cash solution architects and transformation leads. Covers order-to-cash architecture, advanced available-to-promise, SAP Sales Cloud and SAP Commerce Cloud, subscription billing, transportation management, global trade compliance, pricing and margin, Joule and AI, multi-country design, fulfilment monitoring, migration and conversion, extensibility, integration, controls, data volume, testing, troubleshooting and order-to-cash transformation.
prerequisites: Has configured SAP SD in at least one project

Understands S/4HANA deployment options and integration basics
outcomes: Design order-to-cash architectures across S/4HANA, sales channels and logistics
Lead availability, pricing, trade compliance and AI improvements in sales
Plan sales migration, conversion, extensions and integration
Lead order-to-cash transformation with controls, testing and roadmaps
